en: Every push to master runs the behavioural suite, the crate's tests and the coverage measurement. Those runs are the evidence for most of the matrix, and until this claim none of them reached anything a reader could see. CI now keeps what it ran and the result of every test as a recorded execution. Each one carries the commit it ran against and the run it happened in: the run's identifier, its attempt, the workflow, the job, and the address the provider gave. For a pull request, the commit is the merge commit that ran, and the head it was built from is carried beside it.

CI nyní uchovává, co spustilo, a výsledek každého testu jako zaznamenané provedení. Každé nese commit, proti kterému běželo, a běh, v němž proběhlo: identifikátor běhu, pokus, workflow, job a adresu, kterou přidělil provider. en: A release proposes its record as `release/record-<tag>` with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub starts no workflow from an event that token caused: the pull request's own run concludes failure with no job in it and its required `ci` never reports. Until the record is on master, release-check fails `structure` on every open head (the owner kept that check strict on 2026-10-10). For v0.19.0 that window was <n1/> hours (#861, admin-merged after <n2/> h); for v0.19.1 it was <n3/> hours (#866): the dispatched validate went green at the head, branch protection still refused the merge, and a person closed and reopened the pull request <n4/> hours after it was proposed, which is what started the run that let it merge. The dispatch bought nothing but ninety minutes. I2282 records that defect; this issue removes the person from it.
cs: Release navrhne svůj záznam jako `release/record-<tag>` pomocí GITHUB_TOKEN a GitHub nespustí žádné workflow z události, kterou tento token způsobil: vlastní běh pull requestu skončí failure bez jediného jobu a jeho povinné `ci` se nikdy nenahlásí. Dokud záznam není na masteru, release-check selhává v `structure` na každém otevřeném headu (vlastník tuto kontrolu 2026-10-10 ponechal přísnou). U v0.19.0 to okno trvalo <n1/> hodiny (#861, admin-merge po <n2/> h); u v0.19.1 <n3/> hodiny (#866): vyslaná validate prošla na headu, ochrana větve přesto merge odmítla a člověk pull request zavřel a znovu otevřel <n4/> hodiny po jeho navržení, čímž se spustil běh, který merge umožnil.
